apps.name: SNMessenger
apps.subtitle: Messenger tweak with its own sideloaded build
apps.localizedDescription: SNMessenger is a full-featured tweak for Facebook Messenger by NguyenASang, published as a ready-to-sideload IPA built from the official tweak source. Its settings live behind the gear icon in the top-left corner of the Messenger profile screen, which is where every switch is flipped. Upstream documents rootless, rootful and sideload support (Roothide is listed as not supported), iOS 12.4 and newer, and Messenger versions from 458.0.0 up to the latest at release time. Open source under the MIT license.

compatibility.notes: Official project: NguyenASang/SNMessenger. The repository publishes the tweak as a .deb for jailbroken devices plus one ready-to-sideload IPA built from it; that IPA carries whichever Messenger build the maintainer patched for the release, so the version shown here is that build's. Uses the stock com.facebook.Messenger bundle id, so it REPLACES the App Store Messenger.
